messages:
omar: quick flag: onboarding-go sample failing CI. REST /v1/embeddings/batch returns metadata when we pass return_raw_metadata, but go-sdk call returns no metadata and CI shows duplicate indexing jobs.

lucy: can you paste curl + go snippet?

omar: curl works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["p1"], "return_raw_metadata":true}'
```
returns 200 + metadata[].

omar: go snippet (go-sdk v0.6.3):
```go
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, EmbeddingsCreateParams{
  Model: "open-embed-1",
  Inputs: []string{"p1"},
  ReturnRawMetadata: true,
})
```
no metadata in resp; sample-app later NPEs when attaching ids.

dan: two likely culprits: param naming/mapping in the go transport layer, and retry semantics for 202 Accepted. REST sometimes returns 202+Location when metadata backend is slow; SDK currently retries POSTs on non-200 which ended up double-enqueuing indexing jobs.

rachel: addon: in our observed trace token rotate happened mid-flight and SDK retried after refresh which replayed the POST. So we get dupes from both retry-on-non-200 and auth-replay behavior.

lucy: go-sdk historically uses strict typed params and a manual mapper to snake_case. If ReturnRawMetadata was added recently to REST it might not be in the mapper. We should add explicit mapping for ReturnRawMetadata -> return_raw_metadata and a unit test covering both snake_case payload and passthrough of unknown keys.

dan: for retries: embeddings.create should treat 202 as accepted/terminal (queued) — not retryable. We need a route-specific retry policy, not a global non-200 retry. Also, auth middleware should not replay POSTs that already returned 202 on token refresh; that behavior is risky for non-idempotent endpoints.

omar: attached staging logs: POST -> 202 Location:/jobs/q_123, then retry -> POST -> 202 Location:/jobs/q_124. CI shows q_123 then q_124 and sample-app fails.

rachel: mitigation plan: 1) add mapping in go-sdk + unit test; 2) implement a route-level retry policy for embeddings.batch to mark 202 as terminal; 3) change auth middleware to avoid automatic replay of non-idempotent methods after refresh (opt-in replay only); 4) bump sample-app client timeout from 12s to 30s to avoid client-side timeouts triggering retries.

dan: I'll open two PRs: go-sdk#88 (param mapping + tests + changelog note) and infra#213 (auth middleware replay opt-in + tests). Also infra#214 for route-level retry change.

lucy: add an e2e in onboarding sample-app that mocks a 202 + Location and asserts only one job enqueued and no retry by SDK. Add a small README note: experimental flags are snake_case on the wire; SDKs should expose camelCase and map.

infra-bot: recent deploys: embeddings-service v3.3.0 at 2151230000; indexing-worker v2.6.0 at 2151231000

ci-bot: latest CI run: onboarding-go-integration failed at 2151233000 (embed_metadata_test flaky)

omar: thanks. leaving this thread open until PRs merge and CI green. Please tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:
